network:
S=<scratchpad> && cat > $S/e2e.py <<'EOF'
import bottle
app = bottle.Bottle()
app.config['request_id.header'] = 'X-Request-ID'

@app.route('/')
def index(): return 'hi ' + bottle.request.request_id

@app.route('/abort')
def abort_route(): bottle.abort(403, 'no')

app.run(host='127.0.0.1', port=18765, quiet=True)
EOF
cd . && (PYTHONPATH=$PWD python $S/e2e.py &) && sleep 1 && curl -s -i http://127.0.0.1:18765/ ; echo; echo ----; curl -s -i -H 'X-Request-ID: from-client' http://127.0.0.1:18765/abort | head -5; echo ----; curl -s -i http://127.0.0.1:18765/nope | head -4; pkill -f "$S/e2e.py"; echo done
S=<scratchpad> && cd . && (PYTHONPATH=$PWD python $S/e2e.py &) && sleep 1 && curl -s -D - -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:18765/nope; pkill -f "$S/e2e.py"; echo; cd . && git status --short
